02 / A LITTLE ABOUT ME

A clear idea.
A thoughtful layout.
A lasting impression.

Thoughtful design, an open mind, and a faster way from idea to visual.

I’m Sharmila, a Visual Designer who enjoys making complex ideas clear. My approach brings together strong layouts, purposeful storytelling, and AI-assisted exploration—so I can try more directions, iterate quickly, and work productively while keeping a close eye on the details.

At Indium Software, I design presentations and graphics for the Presales Team—from client-facing proposals and pitch decks to templates, infographics, mailers, and posters. Across my design practice, I use familiar creative tools alongside AI to develop and refine ideas.
